{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the two channels exist and are correctly named
channel_counts = df['channel'].value_counts()
print('Channel counts:')
print(channel_counts)

# Check for potential confounders: cross-tabulate channel with customer_segment and customer_age
print('\nCross-tabulation: channel vs customer_segment:')
print(pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment']))

print('\nCross-tabulation: channel vs customer_age (mean):')
print(df.groupby('channel')['customer_age'].mean())

# Compute conversion rate for each channel
conversion_rates = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print('\nConversion rates by channel:')
print(conversion_rates)

# Compute the difference (email - paid_search)
difference = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']
print(f'\nDifference (email - paid_search): {difference}')"}
